7505399833713881088.text:
Etched just announced a $700M raise at a $21B valuation, a testament to Etched's fast rise as one of the most promising companies in AI infrastructure. Galaxy has been proud to back Etched since its Series A in 2024. 

From the start, Etched was an early bet on a contrarian thesis: that inference, not training, would become the defining compute challenge of the AI era. Today, that thesis has become real hardware, shipping into production at some of the most demanding customers in the industry.

Congrats to the entire Etched team. We're excited to keep supporting you as you build the infrastructure layer for fast, cheap AI inference.

7505508209982435328.author: Zubair A.
7505508209982435328.text:
Etched just hit a $5B valuation with $1B in sales booked for their AI chip.

Another hardware company betting everything on inference performance.

Here's the pattern I keep seeing: everyone wants to be the next NVIDIA, but nobody wants NVIDIA's margin pressure.

Because when you own the hardware, you own the unit economics. And when the market turns, you own the inventory risk too.

This is exactly why I stay as far from silicon as possible.

No chips. No servers. No manufacturing. Just software that makes *their* hardware more useful.

A good content day starts before you pick up the camera.

We spent the day at Ideas Fest with one of our clients Etched Tech, capturing their experience across an event bringing together 4,000+ founders, creatives and entrepreneurs.

A busy one, but a good one. 🎥

Three 24-year-old Harvard dropouts are going after NVIDIA. They just raised at a $21B valuation.
 
This is part one of Moonshots — a new Charts & Crafts series in partnership with Smartsheet where each company is taking a massive swing. They're either going to totally change the world…or not.
 
Etched isn't only making chips. They're making whole data center racks built specifically for AI inference, which is way, way harder.
 
Here's why it's a prize worth shooting for:
